note: Replace each `url` below with a Stripe Payment Link from the parish Stripe dashboard, then set `configured` to true. Payment Links are public URLs — never place a Stripe secret key (sk_live_… / sk_test_…) in this repository.

demo.note: Renders an interactive mock of the checkout so the parish can review the donor experience before committing to a payment provider. No card is ever charged and the Stripe API is never called. `publishableKey` is Stripe's own sample TEST key from their public documentation; publishable keys are designed to be readable by anyone and cannot move money. Set `enabled` to false to hide the mock.

fee.note: Stripe's US nonprofit rate, used to calculate the optional 'cover processing costs' amount. `fixed` is in cents; `fixedLabel` is the same value formatted for display. Confirm the parish's actual rate before going live.
